answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a long, sequential chain of modular squarings before producing a Wesolowski VDF proof. The next square depends on the previous result, so GPUs cannot shorten one identity’s evaluation through parallel computation; clones can run as separate chains, but each consumes hardware and still faces the same time delay. Like timber hauled to a jetty, nectar offers no shortcut through the sequence.
